summaryHelp.totalInvested: Sum of BUY transaction amounts dated inside the selected year. It excludes buy fees, prior-year buys, and current portfolio value.
summaryHelp.withdrawn: Sum of SELL transaction proceeds dated inside the selected year. It excludes sell fees and does not mean taxable gain.
summaryHelp.annualRoi: Simple annual ROI for the full investment portfolio: ending value plus external income, minus beginning value and net cash flows during the selected year. Percentage is calculated against beginning value plus new money invested.
summaryHelp.annualPortfolioReturn: Return for the selected report year. The amount is absolute return; the percentage adjusts for money moving in or out. Open details to compare the calculation methods.
summaryHelp.realizedGainLoss: FIFO realized gain/loss from selected-year sells only. Each sell is matched to the oldest available buy lots, including lots bought in previous years.
summaryHelp.fees: External cash fees/taxes recorded on selected-year investment transactions, plus COST transactions. Internal unit fees are shown separately and excluded from FIFO gain/loss math.
summaryHelp.beginningEndingValue: Portfolio value at the end of the previous year and at the end of the selected year, based on asset snapshots.
summaryHelp.assetTotalInvested: For this asset, the sum of BUY transaction amounts dated inside the selected year. It excludes buy fees and prior-year buys.
summaryHelp.assetWithdrawn: For this asset, the sum of SELL transaction proceeds dated inside the selected year, before deducting sell fees.
summaryHelp.assetRealizedGainLoss: For this asset, FIFO gain/loss from selected-year sells after acquisition cost and allocated external cash fees.
summaryHelp.assetFees: For this asset, external cash fees/taxes recorded in selected-year transactions, plus COST transactions. Internal unit fees are listed separately.

columnHelp.buyDate: Date of the selected-year buy transaction.
columnHelp.buyUnits: Units acquired in this selected-year buy transaction.
columnHelp.buyAmount: Purchase amount recorded on the BUY transaction, excluding fees.
columnHelp.buyFees: External cash fees/taxes recorded on this buy. If fees were deducted in units, they are not folded into FIFO gain/loss math.
columnHelp.sellDate: Date of the selected-year sell transaction.
columnHelp.sellUnits: Total units sold in that sell transaction.
columnHelp.proceeds: Proportional sell proceeds assigned to this FIFO match. For each match: sell total amount times matched units divided by total sold units.
columnHelp.matchedBuyDate: Date of the buy lot matched by FIFO. Earlier buy lots are consumed before later lots.
columnHelp.matchedUnits: Units from the matched buy lot consumed by this sell.
columnHelp.acquisitionCost: Proportional acquisition cost for the matched units. Formula: buy amount times matched units divided by buy lot units.
columnHelp.allocatedFees: External cash fees allocated to this match: proportional buy fees plus proportional sell fees. Internal unit fees are excluded and shown as warnings.
columnHelp.gainLoss: Proceeds minus proportional sell fees, proportional acquisition cost, and proportional buy fees.

budgetBreakdown.title: Breakdown
budgetBreakdown.help: Use a breakdown to plan several expenses or sources of income within a category, such as electricity, water and internet bills. Give each item a name and a planned amount; the amounts are added up automatically to set the category estimate. Use a single amount when an overall estimate is enough. Actual income and spending are tracked for the category, not each item.
